_schema_notes: Canonical Name Identity Projection (PR1). Second, independent policy-driven join_hash
variant computed via the SAME core/join_key_builder.build_join_key_from_policy() mechanism
used by policies/domain_join_key_policies.json, loaded/validated with the same
core/join_key_policy.load_join_key_policies()/get_domain_join_key_policy() functions.
Every entry's required_items references the single identity item backing that domain's
own label.display value (see DECISIONS.md D-037).
join_key_schema is 'name_identity.join_key.v1' for every domain except phases, which uses
'phases.name_identity.join_key.v1.redundant' -- phases' join_hash (configuration policy)
already keys off phase.name, the same string this policy keys off, so the two projections
are expected to be near-tautologically identical for that one domain (Step 0 addendum A.4).
Domains not present in this file were explicitly excluded during Step-0-within-PR1 tracing:
- no name-like key at all: units, line_styles, object_styles_* (4), view_category_overrides*
(coordinator + model + annotation)
- name-shaped required item names a different, referenced element, not this record's own
label: dimension_types_spot_coordinate, dimension_types_spot_elevation (dim_type.symbol_name
names a referenced tick-mark/leader symbol, not the dimension type itself)
- only candidate item is a UID-preferring composite, not a name string:
view_filter_applications_view_templates (vfa.template_uid_or_namekey uses the referenced
view template's UniqueId whenever present, falling back to its name only when UID is
absent -- unsuitable for a cross-file name projection); left as an open follow-up.
required_items below reference items that, for identity/phase_filters/line_patterns/
fill_patterns_*/arrowheads/loaded_family_types/view_templates_*/view_filter_definitions/
dimension_types_{linear,angular,radial,diameter,spot_slope}, do NOT exist in those domains'
canonical identity_items list (they live only in a phase2 cosmetic/coordination/unknown
bucket, or nowhere at all) -- the extractor wiring for these domains builds a LOCAL,
name-key-call-only widened items list (identity_items + one freshly-wrapped item) rather
than mutating identity_basis.items/sig_hash/join_hash. See per-domain code comments.

notes: Redundant with this domain's own join_hash by construction: phases.join_key_policy's
sole required item is also phase.name (D-010: phase names are deliberately included in
behavioral hashes for cross-project comparability). Downstream correspondence/divergence
reporting must not present this domain alongside genuinely independent domains without
qualifying it as redundant -- hence the '.redundant' schema suffix rather than a silent
identical-looking entry.
